messages.text: Saturday, November 21 · Canton, Michigan
Morning fog, a light-day of distance, and the shift in Lansing

A thick blanket of fog gives way to a mild, sixty-degree day in Canton. We look today at the shifting political landscape in the state capitol and the immense distance Voyager 1 has traveled into the dark.
Expect fog throughout the day with a high near 62 degrees and a low of 37 degrees.
The sun rises at 7:32 AM and sets at 5:07 PM, with a waxing gibbous moon that is 85.1 percent illuminated.
A quiet Friday in the mist
With no local public events on the calendar for today, it is a morning to enjoy the stillness or attend the Girls Gear Up outreach event at 7:30 AM.
Mark your calendar for the 862 meeting coming up on November 25 at 6:30 PM.
New legislative tides in Lansing

Incoming House Speaker Ranjeev Puri of Canton will lead a legislature featuring a growing progressive caucus in 2027. This group is expected to advocate for corporate tax increases and government ethics reforms.
Weekend options in Ann Arbor
Consider the lecture on the history of the G bugle at the Earl V. Moore Building tomorrow at 5:00 PM or the staged reading of The Boy at the Edge of Everything at the Keene Theater at 7:00 PM.

Sunday, November 22 · Canton, Michigan
Foggy stillness and the reach of a signal one light-day away
A blanket of fog settles over Canton today as temperatures climb toward a mild high. We look toward the horizon, from local jazz performances to the latest milestone in deep-space communication.
Expect fog throughout the day with a high near 65 degrees and a low around 33 degrees, accompanied by a 57 percent chance of precipitation.
The sun rises at 7:33 AM and sets at 5:07 PM, with a waxing gibbous moon that is 92.1 percent illuminated.
An evening of music and theater
The Earl V. Moore Building in Ann Arbor hosts Small Jazz Ensembles at 7:00 PM. Alternatively, the Keene Theater presents a staged reading of The Boy at the Edge of Everything at the same time.
A community meeting is scheduled for November 25 at 6:30 PM.
Legislative shifts and regional research

Incoming House Speaker Ranjeev Puri of Canton prepares to lead a legislature with a larger progressive caucus in 2027. Meanwhile, Ypsilanti Township is organizing a panel at Eastern Michigan University to discuss the proposed University of Michigan and Los Alamos National Laboratory computing center.
A shift to winter
Prepare for a transition to heavy snow tomorrow, when temperatures are expected to drop to a high of 47 degrees.
